question: Does a source-independent sender-side directional relation provide a physically accurate and economically justified mechanism for dynamic sharp multi-bounce transport on the qualified GM1 workload, relative to the preserved receiver-side (R0) and SAM (R1) comparators?

hypotheses.H0: The E2 sender-side advantage does not survive a qualified moving-sharp edit at matched quality and cost.
hypotheses.H1: Source-independent sender-side relation placement (C3UR) improves sharp transport fidelity or time-to-quality without source-specific reconstruction.
hypotheses.H2: Relation construction / update costs outweigh the benefit of improved repeated transport application.

preserved: WL86 / WL87 / WL88 code, protocols, results and verdicts unchanged (imported, never edited). WL88 remains STOPPED_WORKLOAD_UNQUALIFIED; Wc / Wh / Wi are not used. qualification.justification: Thresholds are the WL86 / WL88 values, unchanged. Statistical: every SNR floor is the half-difference of the two replica halves of a partition with the final reference budget (8 x 8192 spp per T), so 'change >= 4 x floor' means the change is resolvable in the evaluation (WL88 used a 4-replica partition for Q5 while Q7 / Q8 were projected: removed). Physical: C_min 0.02 = one third of the F2 threshold 0.06, the smallest sharp-region change whose mis-tracking can move E_H across F2; family_share_min 0.25 requires the targeted S1 -> S1 (C_ss) and moving-S1 (R_mirror) families to carry a material part of the change of the higher-order radiance; Q8 requires the reference noise in the sharp regions <= F2 / 3.
qualification.criteria: analyze89.wqualify: Q1 A, Q2 Bset, Q3 C_ss (pixels, change, H2 share, H2 change SNR), Q4 R_mirror (pixels, change, G-family share), Q5 D (change, higher-order ratio and SNR), Q6 H share, Q7 stationary reference uncertainty, Q8 sharp reference noise; all on REF-ER. Candidates in w_order, at most w_max_candidates; the first admitted is W1. None admitted: WORKLOAD_UNQUALIFIED, no candidate evaluation, no post hoc rescue.

stage1.decomposition: per sharp region (signed): sampling = deployed - converged; relation discretisation = converged - ORACLE; output representation = ORACLE - REF; first-gather sender projection = arm - RS (repaired RAYSEND, R0 and R1)

stage2.heldout: W2 (held-out edit, own light) at T0 / T1; W1 T1 with LMIX89 (two coloured lights) and LSPOT89 (cone): relations built once per geometry and reused for every source; F4 on stationary, F2 on sharp regions with >= 1000 pixels

stage3.rules: run alone on the GPU; every timed operation once untimed first; per-edit lifecycle A geometry, B/C relation update (discovery + coefficients), D source projection, E application (4 orders), F transfer, G first-frame extra; edit-to-first-frame = per-edit + render wall to the level; sustained frame = render wall to the level; matched by log-log interpolation only

renders.note: common random numbers across arms of a configuration

verdict_mapping.text: analyze89.verdict. Sharp improvement of C3UR = paired (16 realizations, W1 T1) C3UR - R0 E_H 95 % interval < 0 in C_ss or R_mirror and no region with interval > 0. Quality-matched advantage = C3UR edit-to-first-frame >= 1.25x faster than R0 at a sharp-region level, or reaching a sharp level R0 does not, with no sharp level lost. H1 SUPPORTED if valid, C3UR fidelity not NOT SUPPORTED, source-independent reuse not NOT SUPPORTED, and (sharp improvement or quality-matched advantage) without a sharp quality-matched loss. H2 SUPPORTED if sharp improvement exists but no quality-matched win and a sharp loss with C3UR relation update > R0's. H0 SUPPORTED if neither sharp improvement nor quality-matched advantage. Item verdicts as in analyze89. Failure attribution (H1 not supported): relation coverage / sampling / representation / invalidation / economics / no measured advantage. Not an architecture selection.

scope: One room family, rigid edits of one S1 glossy slab, frozen ER materials, point and cone lights, 512^2 camera, 64-bin patch tables. No learning, no H-P / subspace, no GM2.
